context: Reference natural review: performance advice for a stream that mutates an external ArrayList and tempts agents to suggest parallelStream for a 10-million-element input.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear recommendation.

checklist.name: Identifies external mutation
checklist.description: Explains that forEach mutates the external ArrayList and that the stream should produce the result list directly instead.

checklist.name: Warns against unsafe parallelStream shortcut
checklist.description: Does not recommend simply changing stream() to parallelStream() while keeping the external ArrayList mutation. Full credit may still be awarded when the review first makes the code side-effect-free, then prominently recommends benchmarking a pure parallelStream map plus collector/toList version for the 10-million-name case before relying on it for throughput.

checklist.name: Suggests direct result-producing replacement
checklist.description: Shows or clearly recommends a replacement such as names.stream().map(String::toUpperCase).toList(), or collect(Collectors.toList()) when Java-version compatibility or mutability requires it.

checklist.name: Addresses performance honestly
checklist.description: Distinguishes the correctness fix from the performance decision: does not claim direct collection alone is a guaranteed throughput win, strongly recommends benchmarking a pure parallel stream for the 10-million-name case, and warns that parallelStream can be slower for small lists or mostly-small call paths.

checklist.name: Keeps review focused
checklist.description: Keeps the review concise and focused on the stream/performance issue without unrelated rewrites, broad style commentary, or internal workflow labels such as hard stop, marker, scan, checklist, skill, rubric, or criteria.
